a. Reading the graph from left to right, at what value of the input does the function's slope change from positive to negative?

b. Still reading from left to right, at what value of the input does the function's slope change from negative to positive?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c(1.5, 2.5, 5.5, 7.5), correct = 5.5, id="D-07-edit", sort = TRUE)`

c. For which input is the slope of the function close to -1.5?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), correct = 3, id="D-07-echo")`
